decisions.cancel_condition: Cancel if unfilled at valid_until, if any completed H1 candle closes below 110.86 before entry, or if a high-impact CAD/JPY event becomes imminent within 60 minutes before fill.
decisions.exposure_note: Adds 0.25% CAD-long/JPY-short risk. GBPJPY remains modeled active at 0.25% and the XAUUSD limit remains modeled pending at 0.25%; if all are active, proposed aggregate risk is 0.75%. decisions.reasoning: CADJPY completed the 12:00 UTC H1 candle at 111.025, 0.0905 above the prior 20-bar high of 110.9345. The candle advanced 0.147 from open to close (about 1.45 ATR), spanned about 1.77 ATR, closed near its high, and retained an approximately 0.10-ATR spread. The 110.94 limit seeks a retest of the broken range rather than chasing; the 110.79 stop sits below the preceding consolidation and the 111.315 target provides 2.50R. Cross-checks show concurrent CAD strength in USDCAD while the correlated GBPJPY position is already near target, so added JPY exposure remains capped.

message: TRADE: CADJPY.x BUY_LIMIT breakout-retest selected from a complete fresh 18/18-symbol scan; 0.25% proposed risk, 2.50R, and modeled aggregate/directional exposure within limits.
